Campbellton Road bus rapid transit gets a price tag

MARTA's board heard Thursday that the Campbellton Road bus rapid transit line would cost $85 million to build and open in two phases. Staff projected 8,500 daily riders by the third year of service.

A survey commissioned by the agency found that 62% of residents along the corridor support the project, while 21% oppose it. Staff also said the dedicated lanes could cut congestion on Campbellton Road by 20% in the peak hour, and that the line would save riders a combined 1,900 person-hours per weekday.

The board did not take a vote. Several members asked for a construction schedule before the next meeting.
